subject: storytime
title: The Kissing Hand words
about: Chester the raccoon is nervous about starting school, so his mother shares a family secret: a kiss on his palm that he can press to his cheek whenever he misses her. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Audrey Penn
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A gentle story for any child who finds it hard to say goodbye at the school door.

cards.note: capital C, it is his name; ch is one part; two parts: Ches-ter; er says er
cc is one k sound; oo says long oo; two parts: rac-coon
the o says u; th is one part; er says er: muth-er
ch says k here; oo says long oo: skool
igh says long i, like in light
ow says ow, like in cow
or says or; two parts: for-est
ss is two letters, one sound: s
a says ah and the l is quiet, like in calm: pahm
all regular; n-d at the end
ch is one part; ee says long e
the o says u; ve at the end just says v: luv
ar says or after w: wawrm
two parts: se-cret; the first e says its name: see-kret
f-r blend; ie says short e here; the s says z: frendz
p-l blend; ay says long a, like in day
